name: Dad
overview: Scripture reveals the vital role of fathers in both honoring God and nurturing their children. Fathers are to be respected and honored, as shown in the command to honor father and mother for a blessed life (Exodus 20:12). God’s love and discipline toward His children serve as the ultimate example, with the Lord correcting those He loves just as a father lovingly disciplines his son (Proverbs 3:11-12). The Lord’s compassion toward His people mirrors the tender care a father has for his children (Psalms 103:13), emphasizing the sacred responsibility of fathers to guide and cherish their offspring, who are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3).
